request.description: Animate ONLY the metal rings around this FROZEN plain ivory metal ball. The ball is not a planet: preserve its exact original smooth etched surface and straight hatch lines, no geography or new drawings. Each ring has a SEPARATE rigid spin: vertical hoop rolls over the top and under the bottom in its upright plane; broad middle band revolves horizontally right-to-left in front; upper and lower latitude hoops revolve horizontally in opposite directions; little end hoops slowly spin in their own planes. Move the existing fine engraving with each ring. Rings move independently, never as one cage, without bending or merging. Constant-speed complete turns, continuous forward loop, matching initial and final poses AND velocity. No pauses, easing, rocking, camera movement or whole-object rotation. Central ball stays completely still with unchanged texture and lighting. Preserve the original fine ivory-silver copperplate lines, exact ring count and widths, and correct front/back occlusion.
